boundaries.p: **This folder is the viewer.** Open `index.html` directly from disk. No server, build, account, CDN, remote font or network API is needed to read the companion.

callout.title: Instructions are not execution or machine verification
callout.text: Buttons copy text, navigate, change this guide's theme or record manual progress. They never execute shells, download tools, elevate, change policy/PATH/profile, install, restore packages, authenticate, launch services or contact Azure.

boundaries.p: Start with prerequisites and safe source review. If the laptop is already accepted, skip installations and use the developer path. A stopped partial Microsoft base is not successful Finish/reboot/resume. Preserve installed tools/settings, Copilot accounts and WSL/distro data.

The underlying repository has dated successful hosted checks. Your laptop's setup, Restore, sample requests, approved extension profile and optional AKS delivery still need real human acceptance. See the [evidence register](page:lib-evidence).

kv: Default at least 600px wide and 520px high; short/phone screens use a long page and drawer. `?deck=off` reads the long page; `?deck=on` forces slides.
Previous/Next, section tabs, numbered actor-coloured circles; arrows, Home/End, M for slide list, touch swipe. Deep links such as `#step-6a`, `#slide=3` and `#slide=last`.
/ or Ctrl+K searches local content. ? shows keys. T changes Light/Dark; light is default, `?theme=dark` is explicit. Escape closes overlays.
Tick a step or Mark page done; counters and Resume reflect self-reported progress only. Storage failures are shown; memory-only progress does not survive navigation.
Copies exactly the visible code. Browser clipboard API plus a file:// textarea fallback; blocked copies show a warning. Required unresolved values remain visibly unresolved.

Only a reviewed main SHA may be entered for optional dispatch instructions, kept in this tab's session storage. Never enter credentials, tokens or customer data. Clear tab values is available on value panels.
Use the browser's Print command. Local print styles expose all slide content and omit navigation controls. Online source links are user-clicked only.

controls.p: The complete folder is portable. Keep local `assets`, `data` and `pages` together; copying only `index.html` breaks it. Source/generator files are included for maintainers, but opening the viewer never runs them.
